answer: Sybil weight is capped by trust flow: each verified identity passes a random walk of 20 steps from 50 seed agents, and accounts the walk reaches under 1% of the time earn no rewards. Forging a summit of fake friends gains nothing, since the walk must cross the single ridge of real vouches; 1,000 sybils joined by 5 bridge links still get 5/1000 of the flow. Weakness: colluding insiders sell vouches; fix: shale-thin stake slashed 50% per proven sybil.
